correctness.rationale: Verified 91 squarefree d in [201,350] exactly (independent mobius sieve matches census list; D=d if d=1 mod 4 else 4d holds for all rows; M=sqrt(D)/2 max 18.627936 so p<=17 correct). Re-ran independent verifier verify.py from scratch: [1] squarefree list OK, [2] CF period/unit/regulator/cycles/K/h for all 91 OK (recomputed CF via (m,d,a) recurrence, convergents, half-unit search N=+-1 and N=+-4 odd, exact same-field unit comparison, reduced-form enumeration |a|,|b|<=isqrt(D) with exact reduced predicate, rho permutation closure, disjoint even-length cycles, unique a=1 and a=-1 forms, two-alpha K-cycle agreement, CK==C0 iff N=-1, h=h+ or h+/2), [3] 53 witness chains step-verified (p<=M, Kronecker matches, discriminant holds, rho steps exact, reduced endpoint, narrow_cycle outside {C0,CK}), [4] structures for all 13 h>=4 fields recomputed via Dirichlet composition with coprime-a CRT plus rho reduction (orders match C4/C2xC2/C6/C8 labels), [5] extrema exact (max period 34 unique at 331; max regulator at 331 via exact cross-discriminant integer comparison, runner-up 334 gap 3.776), [6] class-number-formula cross-check at N=2e5 passes; pipeline L-check at N=1e6 passes 91/91 with worst gap/bound 0.0348, so wrong h by factor >=1.5 would exceed bound by ~50x and be detected. Spot-checked norms (x^2-d*y^2)/4==N for all 91, primes_le_M lists, distribution 38xC1/34xC2/6xC3/5xC4/5xC2xC2/2xC6/1xC8 sums to 91. Externally cross-checked three fields against live LMFDB: 2.2.904.1 (Q(sqrt226) h=8 [8] regulator 3.40230664548, fu a+15), 2.2.277.1 (h=1 regulator 7.86825441198, fu 157a+1228 = (2613+157 sqrt277)/2), 2.2.1324.1 (Q(sqrt331) h=1 narrow C2 regulator 36.2563832043) all match census to displayed digits. Confirmed d=277 correction: maximal-order regulator 7.868254..., 6x is 47.209526... matching brief prototype order-norm+1 unit at convergent n=41 (p=159150073798980475849), while minimal order unit is at n=20 with regulator 23.6047...=3x; DRAFT's '6x order regulator' refers to norm+1 unit, terminologically imprecise but numerically correct and material correction (max-R is 331 not 277) holds. Unit minimality rests on standard convergent theory plus 4l search, Legendre exact check 8y<x+y sqrt(d), and growth certificate v_{4l-1}>2 eps0; joint h*R formula plus LMFDB agreement closes the h-vs-R ambiguity (missed smaller unit would require compensating h factor, excluded by composition/cycle counts and external data). No essential inference, boundary condition, or computation found wrong. Minor presentation nuance about 3x vs 6x order regulator does not affect field-regulator claims.

originality.rationale: Live retrieval (arXiv API totalResults 20 for ti:class-number AND ti:real-quadratic; Crossref 1789899 hits for real-quadratic class-number regulator) plus inspection of six distinct sources shows no prior 201-350 interval census with per-class Minkowski prime witnesses plus dual extrema plus single rerunnable artifact. Nearest results: Amir et al. 2209.09283 is supervised ML separating h=1,2,3 with learned formulas, predicts but proves no h and gives no ideal certificates or interval closure; Bernardini 2412.06351 proves h>1 for a sparse explicit-CF family with finitely many possible exceptions, family-theoretic not consecutive-interval; Kopp-Lagarias 2512.11311 studies non-maximal unit-generated orders Z[eps] with discriminants n^2+-4 asymptotically, different objects (orders vs maximal orders in consecutive interval); Lamzouri 1609.01630 gives asymptotic moments of h(d) ordered by eps_d, not per-field certificates; Cherubini et al. consecutive large class numbers proves existence of large h in blocks, not complete table; PARI/GP site provides bnfinit machinery but publishes no 201-350 bundle; LMFDB provides bare per-field h/regulator/structure (confirmed for 226/277/331) but no uniform Minkowski witnesses, no interval maximality proofs, no single verifier. Zero-hit signal for 'class number census + quadratic' in topic scan corroborated by current broad queries returning only family/asymptotic/ML/tool hits. Delta is bundled closure of one gap stratum with witnesses and exact extrema, not restatement of a single table entry.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as a citable closed benchmark, not a textbook restatement or arbitrary slice. Bare h values for d<350 exist in LMFDB/PARI tables, but the bundle is new: full (h, structure, h+, N(eps), l, eps, R to 40 digits) for 91/91, certified nonprincipal prime ideal with full rho chain for each of 53 h>1 fields recheckable in seconds (p<=17 auditability), exact integer proofs that d=331 uniquely maximizes both period (34) and regulator (36.25638..., gap 3.776 to 334), correction of prototype max-R error (47.21 is order norm+1 unit, true field R_277=7.86825...), and analytic class-number-formula cross-check plus from-scratch verifier. Motivated as first full post-textbook block (textbook d<200) with uniform Minkowski auditability and unit/class-group interplay laboratory (e.g., h=8 at minimal period l=1 for d=226; min R 2.7035 at d=221); not a 1% tweak (closure plus extrema) and not unexplained enumeration (every entry explained by CF+Minkowski+BSGS/composition+norm-equation pipeline with per-field self-tests: identity, K^2=C0, inverses, associativity spot checks, well-definedness). Finite computation without new theorem is acknowledged, but closure, witnesses, extrema coincidence, error correction, and rerunnable artifact together exceed bare recomputation and justify future lookup.
